data.name: Azure Dragon's Treasure And 999 Days of Survival
data.detailed_description:
**=== New Commander's Survival Guide (CRUCIAL!) ===**

⚡ After recruiting troops, ALWAYS use Instant Promotion! Boosts stats AND fully heals units - your battle resurrection cheat code!

🏰 Prioritize Core Buildings (Fortress/Stronghold/Castle)! No high-tier barracks without these military command hubs.

⛏️ Month 1-2: Resource Stockpile Mode Activated! Missed key construction windows = game-losing setbacks.

🌐 Faction-Specific Tech Trees: Castle faction unlocks Tier 5+ units rapidly; others require adaptive strategies.

**=== Rogue-lite War Simulation Redefined ===**

Become a randomly assigned faction lord in procedurally generated realms where every run writes new legends:

✅ Build Unique Capitals: Each faction's architectural DNA creates distinct war machines

✅ Manage 4D Warfare: Resource production/magic R&D/hero development/army composition

✅ Explore Tri-World System: Surface/Ocean/Underground realms with 300+ random events

**🗺️ Tri-World Exploration Breakdown**

**🌍 Surface World**

• Permanent buffs: Fairy Rings (+ATK), Swan Lakes (+SPD)

• Resource Havens: Magic Gardens/Watermills

• Hero Temples: Sage Libraries/Arenas

• Legendary Recruits: Holy Dragons & righteous forces

**🌊 Oceanic Realm**

• Magic Academy Hotspot: 2x Spell Altars

• Obelisk Clusters: Craft legendary artifact materials

• High-risk navigation: Limited resources, maximum mystery

**⚫ Underground Network**

• Black Market Deals: Premium artifacts 40% cheaper

• Forbidden Knowledge: Learn Tier 5 spells in Pyramids

• Shadow Enhancements: Thieves' Guilds/Dark Veils

• Evil Legion Recruits: Hydras & chaotic mercenaries

**🌀 Dimension Rifts**

High-stakes portals offering:

• Gauntlet Mode: 10-wave survival challenges

• Treasure Vaults: Epic loot showers

• No exit until cleared - gamble with fate!

**⚔️ Dynasty Warfare System**

Monthly kingdom-ending sieges! Conquer enemy capitals by Month 7 to unlock dual-faction gameplay. Warning: AI launches coordinated counterattacks!

**🎮 Deep Progression Systems**

**🔥 Hero Customization 2.0**

• 8 Equipment Slots + Unlimited Backpack Artifacts

• 27 Specializations (Alchemy/Summoning/etc.)

• Dual-stat Growth: Magic Might/Combat Prowess

**⚡ Army Evolution Tree**

• Duplicate Merging: Power up existing units

• Faction Synergies: 15% stat boosts per matching type

• Terrain Tactics: Naval/Underground combat modifiers

**💎 Economic Warfare**

Early Game: Scavenger Mode - optimize every resource

Late Game: Imperial Wealth - steamroll with stockpiles

**=== Gameplay Features ===**

• Streamlined Triple-Choice Mechanics

• 300+ Strategic Buildings

• 150 Legendary Heroes

• 85 Reality-Bending Spells

• 27 Specialization Paths

• 3D Battle Arenas

• Dynamic Faction Rivalries

**🌟 Simple clicks conceal war simulation depth - each decision reshapes entire battlefronts! Ready for infinitely replayable conquest?**

Upgrade heroes and troops in - game, yet resource collection is key.. A simple three - choose - one operation integrates various strategies.
